text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. A scratch like this
is a regular occurrence for me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Tsuyoshi is in tip-top shape!
I'm ready for training anytime!
choice_data_list: Then let's resume, but be careful.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Tsuyoshi is in tip-top shape!
I'm ready for training anytime!
choice_data_list: Then let's resume, but be careful.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No, but... I'm telling you, I'm totally used to it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Okay.
Understood. I will rest with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“Still, tomorrow! I'll work hard enough
to make up for today, you'll see!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I managed to convince Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi for today and wrapped up our training session.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow... I thought that was a door, but it's a wall...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her concentration has dropped.
Rushing things won't lead to good training, so I decided to give her the rest of the day off.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Actually, I've got something special
saved just for times like this!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
When you're injured, this is the way to go!
Targeted strength training for uninjured muscle groups!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If we do it part by part,
you won't have to force your injured areas to move!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hehehe~! A little injury
can't stop Tsuyoshi's growth, y'know!
